meta.name: exec-briefing-memo
meta.description: Decision needed + recommendation + evidence + tradeoffs, 把复杂材料压成可拍板的一页

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂材料压成可拍板的一页简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速从长篇材料提炼决策要点
copy.tagline_en: Condense complex materials into a one-page decision memo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly distill key decision points from lengthy materials

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会生成一页高管决策简报：帮您把长会议记录、调研材料等复杂信息压缩成含决策问题、建议、事实证据、权衡表、风险和下一步行动的 memo。
howto.when: 当您需要快速拍板，并提供会议记录、战略讨论等碎片信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一页高管决策简报，主题是是否进入Enterprise Plan。
say.note: 输出包含推荐、权衡、下一步决策路径的 memo。

say.text: 根据销售反馈和产品数据，做一份决策 memo，给出推荐。
say.note: 基于您提供的材料输出结构化简报。

say.text: 用 board-memo 风格生成紧急决策简报。
say.note: 指定默认风格，产出一页浅色高管 memo。

howto.what_en: Enable Claude to produce a one-page executive briefing memo: compress complex meeting notes, research materials, etc., into a decision-ready memo with problem, recommendation, evidence, tradeoffs, risks, and next actions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need a quick decision and provide messy information like meeting minutes or strategic discussion notes.

say_en.text: Generate a one-page exec briefing memo on whether to enter the Enterprise Plan.
say_en.note: Outputs a memo with recommendation, tradeoffs, and next steps.

say_en.text: Create a decision memo from sales feedback and product data, with a recommendation.
say_en.note: Structures your provided materials into a briefing.

say_en.text: Use board-memo style for an urgent decision briefing.
say_en.note: Default style: a light-colored one-page exec memo.
